textRun.content: Project Phoenix Overview
Objective: Migrate legacy monolith to microservices architecture.

Timeline: Q1-Q2 2026
Team Lead: Marcus Johnson
Team Size: 8 engineers

Milestones:
- Phase 1: Service decomposition (complete)
- Phase 2: Data migration (in progress)
- Phase 3: Traffic cutover (planned for May)


--- Status Note (March 19, 2026) ---
Phase 1 service decomposition complete. Phase 2 data migration actively in progress under Marcus Johnson and team of 8 engineers. Phase 3 traffic cutover still planned for May. Migration pace should be monitored to confirm May timeline remains realistic.
Project Atlas Design Doc
Goal: Build a unified search platform for all company data sources.

Architecture:
- Elasticsearch cluster for full-text search
- Custom ranking algorithm using ML
- REST API with GraphQL gateway

Expected launch: June 2026


--- Status Note (March 19, 2026) ---
Unified search platform on track for June 2026 launch. Elasticsearch cluster and GraphQL gateway architecture defined; ML ranking algorithm still in development. Next step: finalize ranking model and begin API integration testing.
Project Horizon Proposal
Proposed initiative to expand into the European market.

Key activities:
- GDPR compliance audit
- Localization of product for 5 languages
- Partnership with EU cloud providers

Budget request: $500,000
Expected timeline: 6 months


--- Status Note (March 19, 2026) ---
European market expansion proposal still in pre-approval stage. $500K budget request pending. GDPR compliance audit and 5-language localization scope defined but not started. EU cloud provider partnerships need to be scouted before this can move to execution.
Project Velocity Sprint Plan

Sprint 5 objectives:
- Complete user authentication redesign
- Implement rate limiting middleware
- Deploy canary release infrastructure

Sprint duration: March 10 - March 24, 2026


--- Status Note (March 19, 2026) ---
Sprint 5 is mid-cycle (March 10–24). Auth redesign and rate limiting middleware are in active development. Canary release infrastructure not yet started — team should confirm it can begin before sprint close on March 24.
